findings.issue: 九時 as a clock time is always read くじ, never きゅうじ (like 四時=よじ, 七時=しちじ). The kana gives ごぜんきゅうじ, teaching a wrong time reading — core N5 material.
findings.current: としょかんわごぜんきゅうじからごごはちじまでです。
findings.suggested: としょかんわごぜんくじからごごはちじまでです。

findings.issue: Numeral 九 in 九時 (clock hour) is read く, not きゅう; the token reading must match the only correct pronunciation くじ.
会社帰り takes rendaku: かいしゃがえり (cf. 仕事帰り=しごとがえり, 学校帰り=がっこうがえり). Kana has かいしゃかえり without rendaku — wrong reading.
findings.current: みせのしたしらべのためかいしゃかえりによることにした。
findings.suggested: みせのしたしらべのためかいしゃがえりによることにした。

findings.issue: 帰り as the second element of the compound 会社帰り is voiced by rendaku: がえり, not かえり.
Romaji carries the same wrong reading: kyuuji should be kuji (九時=くじ).
Romaji carries the same missing rendaku: kaishakaeri should be kaishagaeri (会社帰り=かいしゃがえり).
In どうでもよかった, よかった means 'was fine (either way)'; the whole idiom means 'it did NOT matter'. Glossing the in-context sense as 'it mattered' teaches the opposite meaning.
findings.current: good, OK (here: 'it mattered / it was fine')
findings.suggested: good, OK (in どうでもいい: 'any way was fine' → 'it didn't matter')

findings.issue: Same defect in pt: 'importava' sugere o sentido oposto — どうでもよかった significa 'tanto fazia / não importava'; よかった sozinho é 'estava bem (de qualquer jeito)'.
findings.suggested: bom, OK (em どうでもいい: 'tanto fazia', 'estava bem de qualquer jeito')

findings.issue: ため here is purpose (lit_en correctly has 'For the sake of'), but 'Por causa da' reads as cause in Portuguese, misstating the relation; purpose mirror should use 'Para'.
findings.current: Por causa da pesquisa-prévia da loja, na volta da empresa, decidi passar (= o passar, fixei em).
findings.suggested: Para a pesquisa-prévia da loja, na volta da empresa, decidi passar (= o passar, fixei em).

findings.issue: Two missing accents: 'Horrivel' should be 'Horrível' and 'esta-virando' should be 'está-virando'.
Object particle を left as を instead of お, deviating from the corpus phonetic convention (は→わ, へ→え, を→お) that every other particle in this batch follows.
findings.current: そっとかいだんをのぼった。
findings.suggested: そっとかいだんおのぼった。
